P01.rationale: No founder or person is used as a dominant human anchor; the page relies entirely on typographic elements and text blocks.

P05.rationale: There are no case studies with framed client portraits; only numbered points without associated imagery.

P07.rationale: No social-proof apparatus such as press logos, rating cards, or testimonials is present on the page.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements (the large '01' through '06') are clearly present and serve as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations bound to numbers are present in the form of specific metrics like '12 bis 24 Stunden', '30 Minuten pro Kunde', etc., which function as before/after or cost-math elements.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and typographic structure.

P13.rationale: The background is flat blankness (off-white) without any intentional texture or atmosphere appropriate to the content.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion regarding treatment of overlaid text does not apply.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone/laptop/book) is shown to add credibility; only typographic elements are present.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists entirely of text and numbers rather than specific business photos, making it generic by default due to lack of real-world context.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content across most of the page area.

N10.rationale: No text sits on a busy photo without scrim because there are no photos present to create such an issue.
